CALCULATOR_PAGE_SUBTITLE: Estimate your food waste volume and see which Griffon digester is the best fit for your site.
CALCULATOR_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION: Select the option that best matches the location where food waste is generated.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_DESCRIPTION: Use the method you already know best. You can estimate by meals, people, capacity, or direct daily waste.
CALCULATOR_RESULT_EMPTY: Choose a category and enter your values on the left. The estimate appears here as soon as the details are complete.
CALCULATOR_ESTIMATED_WASTE: Based on your input, here is the estimated quantity of food waste your site may generate.
CALCULATOR_CUSTOM_SOLUTION_DESCRIPTION: Your estimated volume is above 1000 kg/day. Ecoflow should review the exact waste profile and may recommend a multi-unit setup or a custom configuration.
CALCULATOR_DISCLAIMER: Published capacities and recommendation thresholds are not the same.
CALCULATOR_DISCLAIMER_SUBTITLE: Actual processing performance depends on the composition and type of food.
CALCULATOR_POSITIVE_NUMBER_ERROR: Enter a valid positive number greater than zero.
CALCULATOR_DAYS_RANGE_ERROR: Operating days must be a whole number between 1 and 7.
CALCULATOR_MAX_VALUE_ERROR: Entered value is above the supported range for this first version.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_MEALS_DESCRIPTION: Best when you know how many meals your site serves on a typical day.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_STUDENTS_DESCRIPTION: Use student count when meal volumes are not available yet.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_EMPLOYEES_DESCRIPTION: Use employee count as a quick proxy for canteens, stores, and hotel support operations.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_BEDS_DESCRIPTION: Useful for hospitals, institutions, and care environments with meal service tied to bed capacity.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_ROOMS_DESCRIPTION: Useful for hotels and accommodation facilities when room count is easier to estimate than meals.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_RESIDENTS_DESCRIPTION: Estimate based on the number of residents in facilities with regular meal service.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_HOUSEHOLD_MEMBERS_DESC: Use the number of people living in the household.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_SEATS_DESCRIPTION: Useful for venues where seating capacity is a better proxy than measured waste.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_VISITORS_DESCRIPTION: Estimate using the daily number of guests, attendees, or visitors.
CALCULATOR_METHOD_KNOWN_DAILY_WASTE_DESC: Use this when you already measure or estimate food waste directly in kilograms per day.
